description: Step 2 of 2. Sends the confirmed quote request to the HLN sales team and emails the buyer a receipt. Call it only after the buyer explicitly confirmed the preview_inquiry summary, with exactly the same fields and its confirmation_token. Attachment links are downloaded and stored privately.

attachment_urls.description: Up to 3 https links to the buyer’s files (tech pack, sketch, reference photo): the download URL of a file the buyer uploaded in this chat, or a public share link. PDF, Word, Excel, JPG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB each.

email.description: Buyer's real email address. The sales team replies here, and a receipt is sent to it.

language.description: Language for the receipt email: en, es or fr

message.description: What the buyer needs: styles, fabric, GSM, colours, decoration, sizes, target date, target price. Write it in the buyer’s words; do not invent requirements.

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp number, with country code

product_interest.description: Product type, e.g. "heavyweight hoodies" or "yoga leggings"

quantity.description: Estimated order size per style and colour

name: submit_inquiry
title: Send a quote inquiry
